## What it is
rag-shared is a shared utilities package for RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) orchestration services. It provides logging, observability, and caching utilities to support RAG workflows.

## Current capabilities
- Readable Logging (Milvus-style format)
- OpenTelemetry Observability (distributed tracing with OTLP export, optional)
- Dragonfly/Redis Client (cache client for inter-service data sharing)

## Maturity
Versioned releases observed (v2.0.0).
